name: helper-text
purpose: Auxiliary text rendered below a form input to communicate guidance (`helper`), validation errors (`invalid`), required-field reminders (`required`), or a locked/disabled state (`disabled`). Each variant changes only color (and, for `disabled`, prepends a lock icon) so the visual weight stays consistent with the field above it.
useWhen: Use HelperText only under a control that is not inside Field; inside Field use Field.Description or Field.Error. For a one-sentence note beside a label use Hint.
Guidance under a bare input you compose yourself (format hints, limits).
A validation error (`type="invalid"`), a required reminder (`type="required"`), or a locked-field notice (`type="disabled"`) under a field.
avoidWhen: A standard form field → use `field`, whose `Field.Description` / `Field.Error` render this helper and wire it to the control.
The field name or required marker above the input → use `Field.Label`.
Feedback about a whole form or page rather than one field → use `alert`.
related: Field.Label` — sits above the input; HelperText sits below it.
field` — `Field.Description` switches the helper `type` from the Field's `disabled`, `invalid` and `required` state.
alert` — banner-level feedback with severity and an optional action.
bestPractices: Give it an `id` and point the input's `aria-describedby` at it so screen readers read it with the field.
Pick `type` from the field state: `invalid` for errors, `required` for a missing required value, `disabled` when the field is locked.
Keep it to one short line; `type="disabled"` already prepends the lock icon, so do not add another.

props.name: label
props.doc: Fallback text when the default slot is empty.

props.name: type
props.doc: Visual variant; `disabled` also prepends a `ai ai-lock` icon.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Helper text; falls back to `label` prop when empty.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import HelperText from '@aziontech/webkit/helper-text'
</script>

<template>
  <HelperText
    type="helper"
    label="Helper Text"
  />
</template>
